title: Qualify pinned IPFS backend

scope.assurance_scope: PCPR Python v1 Phase-2 Kit pinned IPFS backend qualification only
scope.implementation_delta: Add LivePinnedIpfsAdapter@1 and PinnedIpfsQualification@1. The live adapter talks to Kubo over stdlib HTTP, never auto-installs, rejects secret material, and fails closed when a daemon is absent. Injected transports are labeled simulated and cannot mint live qualification. Sealed validation PATH has no ipfs executable and no digest-bound Kubo deployment, so clean provisioning, add, read-back, digest, pin, unpin, restart, daemon loss, timeout, concurrency, large objects, unexpected content, configuration, upgrade, rollback, and interface parity stay typed unavailable. Hermetic candidate tests do not represent simulated results as live. This evaluator never writes DuckDB or Quack state and never emits a closed PCPR release outcome.
